science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: Hector squinted at the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, watching the deep crimson waves surge like bruised flesh. The deafening hum of the induction coils rattled his teeth, bringing with it the acrid stench of ozone and scorched brass that clung to the damp, heavy air. The static tang of raw electricity sat on his tongue like a copper coin as he prepared to physically hand over the diagnostics baton to Kaio, who had to DEFEND the delicate calibrations, ATTRACT the stray magnetic flux away from the primary conduit, and CONCEAL the overloaded capacitor bank before it triggered a catastrophic cascade.
